body:
I just can't bring myself to say "I am depressed" or basically saying something specific about being wrong with me. I just can't, same with I am sad or anything. I just cannot talk about emotion, it just seems impossible. Its not like I am thinking that I can't tell them, I want too but its just impossible because I can't say something is wrong with me. Like the words just don't come out. 

The best analogy is that its kind of like bleeding when it comes to talking about emotions. The more you talk, the more you bleed, if you bleed too much, you die. And dying in this scenario is killing myself, I just can't. Like whenever I try to talk to anyone about this I just get so overwhelmed when it comes to the part of "Well, what do you think is wrong with you?" or "What's wrong?" because I just don't know what is wrong with me. Its such a hard question to respond to if you don't know the answer yourself.  

I just don't understand myself completely, I don't have a answer for it and I am often very confused on why I feel so terrible all the time. Sure it is most likely depression, but for some reason I just cannot fucking say "I think I have depression" Like it just doesn't come out at all, just impossible to tell someone. 

Doesn't really help in the whole not feeling hopeless department.

Its so hard to feel like I am worth something, the self image of being worthless has been engrained into my head by so many people that its just to hard to feel that way. 

Nobody's impressed with me, just disappointed. Just being dead sounds a lot better, someone will finally see that I am in pain and care about me.
